entries.what: Rendle (2016) PhD thesis, University of Plymouth: as-built bag layout, as-built crest levels and survey datum (P5)
entries.detail: The thesis has NO as-built plan. Fig 5.3 (p.95) is the ASR Ltd design bag layout of 18 Dec 2006 (no scale or coordinates, about 46 labelled bags, footprint 4,474 m2, crest 0.3 m CD); the text says 32 containers were built. Four council bathymetry surveys exist (Oct 2009 as-built, May 2010, Oct 2010, Apr 2011) but only Apr 2011 is shown in plan (Fig 5.7, OS-grid axes), which the model already uses; a spring 2012 survey was withheld by the council. Datum wording is loose (Fig 5.6 'relative to MSL', values fit chart datum; '1.66 mODN = MSL' vs the model's 1.40). Its other facts (crest about +0.5 m CD built, costs, Davidson 2010 criteria) are card references (R17). Before Lior supplied the PDF, the PEARL page returned a Cloudflare bot check and academia.edu / ResearchGate gave 403 (not bypassed), so only search snippets were available.
entries.might_work: Council / CCO survey data: Lior E10 (BCP Council) and E8 (Channel Coastal Observatory)

entries.what: Bournemouth council / Channel Coastal Observatory reef bathymetry: Oct 2009 as-built survey, 2010-2012 surveys, nearshore and offshore single- or multibeam data of Poole Bay at Boscombe
entries.where: https://coastalmonitoring.org (CCO map viewer and contact form); Bournemouth, Christchurch and Poole (BCP) Council
entries.by: agent: Boscombe 3D agent, seabed extension run (cloud)
entries.detail: CCO beach-profile lines were found through the viewer's own WFS service and used (11 lines, mostly 2010-04-20), but no CCO or council reef bathymetry for 2009-2012 is public; the spring 2012 survey was withheld. The seabed seaward of the Fig 9 survey is therefore a spline blend (+-0.5 m) and an EMODnet slope extension (+-1.2 m). Claude never sends e-mail.
entries.might_work: Lior: E8 (CCO) and E10 (BCP Council); D2 in the 3D requests

entries.what: EMODnet CDI survey records 117452 (EDMO 2607, OceanWise) and 1982230 ('Poole Bay, Blocks 14-17'): survey date and vertical datum; and EMODnet DTM 2024 levels at the reef
entries.by: agent: EMODnet bathymetry agent (cloud, own headless Chrome)
entries.detail: The CDI pages sit behind a 'Checking your browser' JavaScript check (plain HTTP) and a 'Web Page Blocked' firewall page (headless Chrome); the survey date and datum were not read (the 2011-2012 date is an inference from quality-index age classes; the record's extent ends 2.5 km south of the reef and its identity with the cells is unconfirmed). The DTM cell at the reef (115.8 x 73.4 m, mean -5.62 m LAT, 12 soundings) is 1.1-3.1 m deeper than the Fig 9 survey and the Navionics soundings, with an unattributed offset, so only its LAT datum statement and the seaward gradient (-1.41 %) are used, not levels. No finer EMODnet data (nearest HR DTM 106 km away).
entries.might_work: Lior: W1 (open the CDI 117452 page in a normal browser; EMODnet viewer 'Source Reference of the DTM')

entries.result: other: datum, survey date and drying height not shown
entries.detail: Nautical Chart and SonarChart load without login or CAPTCHA and give soundings and the shoal area (a green drying patch about 12.7 m from the survey peak), but the viewer states no depth datum, no survey or update date and prints no drying height; whether the shoal is the 2011 survey, a later one or crowd-sourced is unknown. Datum assumption A3 (chart datum) rests on a 1-2 % area match, not proof.

entries.detail: Boscombe-Arial is oblique (pier at the left, no usable control); Boscombe-From-Above is near-nadir but has no scale or north; the Wavelength Mag image is a sign and a sand heap, not the reef; the bournemouthswell design diagram is only 100 x 39 px; the Wikimedia 'layout' diagram is a cartoon of tube cross-sections forming a ramp. Used as context at most.

entries.detail: Viewed directly: a dry, wind-rippled sand heap with footprints behind a temporary fence and the 'Surf reef' safety sign; no sea, waterline or reef bags, so the earlier description 'exposed reef mound at extreme low tide' is not supported. Not usable for crest or planform.

entries.what: Gemini's Boscombe sources: Bournemouth Council 'Boscombe Reef Review (2012)', Halcrow 'Independent Engineering Audit (2011)', RWR 'Dossier (2024)', 'Davidson (2010) Final Performance Report', 'Harrow et al. 2012 multibeam'
entries.by: agent: Boscombe tracer, verifier and source audit (cloud)
entries.detail: No URLs given; searches found no council review and no Halcrow audit. The Davidson (2010) report is a 6-month INTERIM report with surf-quality content and no 100 x 55 m plan. 'Harrow et al. 2012 multibeam' does not exist (the 2012 Plymouth paper is Rendle and Davidson, DGPS bathymetry). The RWR spot page gives only 2.5 acres / 210 m. Gemini's 9,176 m2 quadrilateral is 2.3 times our outline and oriented differently; its 'triangular delta 100 x 55 m' appears in no plan-view source. Gemini lead not confirmed; nothing used.

entries.what: Whether the Dec 2010 planned modification (four extra bags at the south-east corner, three pillow bags to lengthen the right to 65 m) was built
entries.where: Wikipedia 'Boscombe Surf Reef' (Construction, citing Bournemouth Echo 16 Dec 2010); council releases 12 Aug and 24 Oct 2011; BBC 15 Aug 2011
entries.detail: Not documented as built before the 2011 imagery date or afterwards: the council releases only mention repairs to two upper-layer containers ('funds previously allocated for improvement are being used' for repair), the BBC says refinement was still only a plan in August 2011, and repair work continued into spring 2012. The drawn state is therefore the damaged-and-repaired reef of 2011 without the extension.

entries.detail: The ASR construction manual with individual bag capacities was not seen (card gap; only container totals such as T4 746.7 m3 from Rendle Table 5.3). The Fig 9 profile panels use an 'Eastings' axis around 4.21e5 that does not match the plan Eastings (4.11e5) and their scale could not be reconciled with the profile lines (88 units vs a 135 m line), so they were not used; only the plan survey panel was read.

entries.result: other: video not about the structure
entries.detail: Full transcript read: a regeneration and interview piece about the town (run-down history, Overstrand development, beach pods, pier refit). The reef is credited as the catalyst ('it was a catalyst for all of this investment') but the structure is never described or shown. Downgraded to 'mentions the reef briefly'. Another video, 7xMwL09a1TI 'the construction story so far', was classified from its title alone (no description, not transcribed).
